messages:
maya: Heads-up: exec asked for a compact "acceptance checklist" for DP cohorts that product can use in Q2 roadmap reviews. Need something that fits on one slide.

sara: We should keep it operational: what partner must deliver and what we must deliver. Also include gating for launch readiness and a short eviction policy.

tony: From success managers: partners really want clarity on time commitments. Can we standardize "contact cadence" in the checklist? e.g., weekly 30-min sync for first month, then biweekly.

nora: Agree. Also capture the feedback artifact requirements: structured eval (JSON), 2 annotated transcripts OR 3 short freeform notes per sprint.

ops-bot: reminder: dp-onboard automation has templated cadence invites. See /ops/templates/dp-cadence-invite.md

maya: Draft one-slide checklist (compact):
- Recruitment pass: partner self-scores on impact/effort/availability; product review sign-off.
- Integration pass: end-to-end workflow validated in staging within 10 business days.
- Engagement pass: >= 2 active sessions/week OR >=15 API calls/week for 3 of 4 weeks.
- Feedback pass: at least 1 structured eval + 2 qualitative artifacts per two-week sprint.
- Ops pass: runbook, incident contact, and dev traffic SLO <=250ms P95.
- Governance: NDA/SOW signed and data export window specified.
- Eviction: 7-day notice; archive 30d; rehab = 2 good weeks within monitoring window.

maya: Quick poll: thumbs if this is slide-ready

sara: :thumbsup: small tweak: integration timeline -> 14 days to be realistic.

tony: :thumbsup: prefer explicit "support triage" promise in incentives (2 prioritized bugs/month).

nora: :thumbsup: I'll author structured eval template and a short scoring rubric (usability, accuracy, safety).

ops-bot: deployment windows Thurs 18:00 UTC; automation for invites and eviction notices available.

sara: I'll merge this into the slide and add the tiny flow chart: Recruitment -> Onboard -> Trial -> Launch/Exit. Owners: sara (slide + tile), nora (eval template), tony (incentive language), ops (automation).

maya: Thanks. I'll present on Monday. Please ping me if anything blocks.
